absent: Exact numeric values and bit layouts for page table entries and fault status codes are not shown in these fragments.
Allocation and reclamation policies behind anonymous folio preallocation and huge folio allocation are not shown.
Filesystem huge fault method contract and return code handling beyond fallback detection are not shown.
Daemon scan order, sleep intervals, and removal paths are not shown.
Reverse map, LRU insertion, TLB flush, and notifier delivery internals beyond call placement are not shown.

findings.text: Installing a shared zero huge mapping at PMD granularity derives table entry protections from the virtual area, marks the entry special, deposits preallocated table memory, installs the entry at the aligned address, and accounts one more page table.
Anonymous fault preparation delegates to an inner helper and, when the result asks for retry, releases the virtual area read guard before returning.

Enrollment of a virtual area with the background collapse daemon proceeds only when the address space is not already enrolled and when global or per class huge controls plus per area collapse allowability all permit it.

Background huge activity is globally permitted when any of three independent controls permits it, namely the global transparent huge control or the anonymous per size control or the shared memory PMD control.
Anonymous huge support is enabled when the always control is set or when the advise control is set or when the inherit control is set together with global enablement.

Shared memory PMD huge support is denied under the deny setting, otherwise it is enabled when the PMD order appears in any of the always, advise, or within size sets, or when it appears in the inherit set without the never setting.

Address space enrollment allocates a slot, claims enrollment idempotently with a test and set flag, discards the spare slot on repeat enrollment, otherwise links the slot into a hash and appends it behind the scanner cursor, holds a reference, and wakes the daemon only when its queue was previously empty.

Collapse order selection starts from the full anonymous order set when the background daemon scans an anonymous area and otherwise from the single PMD order, then narrows that set through per area allowability based on flags and request type.

Write protection handling at PMD granularity routes anonymous areas to huge anonymous write handling with userfault interplay, routes shared file areas to filesystem huge handling when present, and otherwise splits the huge mapping down to small pages and requests fallback handling.

Huge PMD write fault handling first takes a zero huge fast path, then validates that the table entry is unchanged, reuses the folio when it is already exclusive or uniquely referenced with swap cache detached, and otherwise splits and falls back to small page handling.

PUD splitting brackets work with a notifier range covering the aligned PUD extent, acquires the PUD lock, verifies huge state, clears and flushes the entry once, and performs extra folio accounting only for direct access mappings.

PUD creation and PUD write protection have no anonymous transparent support, delegate file or shared areas to filesystem huge handling when available, otherwise split and report fallback, with one configuration providing an empty split operation.

Small page fault dispatch distinguishes missing tables, swapped out entries, protection only and NUMA hint entries, and present entries, handling unshare and write protection through copy on write, otherwise updating young and dirty access state and avoiding redundant TLB maintenance on retried faults.

Small page write fault handling performs userfault write protection preprocessing, treats shared mappings through shared write paths without copying, reuses an exclusive or reusable anonymous folio in place, and otherwise drops the table lock and performs an allocate and copy sequence.

Copy on write installation drops the table lock across allocation and content copy under a single page notifier range, then reacquires the lock, revalidates entry identity, clears and flushes before installing the new entry, orders reverse map removal after that flush, and releases old references outside the lock.
Enrollment mutation of the shared hash and scan list is serialized by a dedicated daemon lock held only around insertion and queue linkage after the enrollment flag has been claimed.
The slot registry associates each enrolled address space identity with its slot object through a hash linkage plus a stored back pointer to the address space.
Enrollment must not race with teardown, where a zero user count indicates an exiting address space that must not be newly enrolled.

Fault handling distinguishes PMD granularity from PUD granularity and reports abstract outcomes including success with no further action, fallback to smaller granularity, retry, out of memory, and hardware poison.
After any lock drop or concurrent collapse window, handlers recompare the current table entry against the entry seen at fault time and abort harmlessly on mismatch rather than acting on stale state.
